name: Garden Gnome
Desc: 4 Gnomes are placed at start. Flowers placed on top of Gnome double in size.

name: Fountain
Desc: A fountain is placed at start in the center. Flowers placed adjacent score an extra 2% per tile.

name: Fertilizer Bag
Desc: A plot of fertilizer is placed at start. Flowers placed on top can be placed again.

name: Leaf-Blower
Desc: A pile of leaves is placed at start. Flowers placed on top do not take any tiles, but still score as if they did.

name: Lawn Chair
Desc: A lawn chair is placed at start. Flowers placed on top Re-Trigger
